apps.title: UnGodly
apps.summary:
UnGodly is a dark fantasy action RPG where you control every strike, dodge and hero swap in real-time combat. Collect Primals, build your team and fight to save a world being devoured.

The world of Dunmiir is broken. The Devouring consumes what remains, and only the Primals, scarred warriors who wield elemental power, stand between humanity and extinction. This is a mature action RPG built for players who want real action, deep progression and a story with teeth.

REAL-TIME ACTION COMBAT
Every fight is in your hands. Dodge enemy attacks, swap heroes mid-battle, chain ultimates and trigger elemental reactions to break your enemies apart. Combat is fast, heavy and bloody: cut down foes, sever heads and limbs, and earn every victory through skill and timing. If you love hack and slash action games, UnGodly delivers combat with real weight.

COLLECT AND BUILD YOUR PRIMALS
Recruit Primals, warriors shaped by trauma and power, each built for a distinct combat role. Level them up, upgrade gear, unlock awakenings and customize skills to create your own builds. This hero collector RPG rewards experimentation: every Primal opens new team synergies and new ways to play.

A DARK FANTASY WORLD WORTH SAVING
Explore Dunmiir, a shattered fantasy realm ruled by dangerous factions and corrupted gods. Follow a mature story told through cinematic missions, side quests and character-driven role play. Every chapter of this dark fantasy RPG pulls you deeper into a world of blood, betrayal and survival.

BOSSES, EVENTS AND THE NETHERMAW DESCENT
Face brutal bosses that test your mastery of real-time combat. Take on evolving challenges and live events, then push into the Nethermaw Descent and climb the leaderboards to prove your skill.

DEEP RPG PROGRESSION
UnGodly is a true role playing game at its core. Gear, skills, awakenings, story choices and team synergy all feed long-term progression, so every session moves your Primals forward. Play in focused daily sessions or dive in for hours.

BUILT FOR ACTION RPG FANS
If you play role playing games for the combat and the story, and want an action RPG with skill-based fights, a collection of powerful heroes and a dark story worth following, UnGodly is your next game.

apps.title: Hop In One
apps.summary:
One perfect hop. One satisfying finish.

Take a fresh approach to golf in Hop In One. Hold to prepare your shot, release to send the ball hopping, and aim for the hole across colorful courses. A little patience and a well-timed release can make all the difference.

HOLD. RELEASE. HOP.
Get a feel for each shot and find the right moment to let go. Clear the gap, land on the green, and chase the satisfaction of a hole in one.

FIND YOUR WAY TO THE FLAG
Read the course before you hop. Winding fairways, sandy bunkers, and water crossings give you plenty to think about as you work toward a lower score. Will you play it carefully or go straight for the hole?

EXPLORE COLORFUL COURSES
Hop through sunny island greens, autumn landscapes, and rocky highland fairways. Each setting brings a new backdrop to your next shot, from bright coastal waters to paths lined with golden leaves.

CLIMB THE LEAGUES
Put your precision to the test, move up the standings, and work toward promotion. Keep an eye on your rivals as you try to finish each round with fewer shots.

MAKE THE NEXT HOP COUNT
Enjoy simple hold-and-release controls, sharpen your timing, and turn a promising shot into a satisfying finish.

The flag is waiting. Can you hop it in one?

apps.title: The Last Walk: Survival Story
apps.summary:
The army is evacuating the last civilians. Your wife and daughter climb onto the last truck. There is no room for you.

So you walk. Through dead suburbs, empty highways and burnt-out towns, all the way to the coast, across the sea and onto an island under siege. 24 days on the road in a post-apocalyptic world, to find them again.

EVERY ENCOUNTER IS A CHOICE
A wounded stranger begs for a bandage. A lost child is starving. Raiders block the road. A bear escaped from the zoo sleeps across your path. A supermarket hands out free food, a little too freely. Swipe left or right: help or walk away, fight or run, trust or lie. Every choice changes your supplies, your health and the man you become.

SURVIVE THE ROAD
- Manage water, food and health: the road drains them every hour.
- Search the ruins, then buy and sell gear at the traders and markets.
- Arm yourself: nail bat, crowbar, machete, revolver, pump shotgun. Upgrade and reload them at the traders.
- Find a shelter before nightfall, or spend the night outside and fight the Prowlers until dawn.
- Meet people who walk with you for a while, and a stray dog who could change everything.

A FATHER'S STORY
Your family is alive, somewhere ahead. Keep your humanity or keep everything for yourself: the people you help, the ones you leave behind and the risks you take decide how your story ends.

FEATURES
- An interactive story and survival adventure, with real choices and no right answer
- 24 chapters across a ruined country, the coast and an island
- Night fights, markets, weapons and supplies to manage
- A side-scrolling pixel-art world with animated scenes
- Free to play, in short sessions
- Available in 31 languages

apps.title: Vial Magic: Color Sort
apps.summary:
Vial Magic: Color Sort is a single-player water sorting puzzle game with a collectible CG illustration gallery. Players solve levels by moving colored liquid between bottles, then progress through the game to unlock pictures for their collection.

WHAT YOU DO IN THE GAME

The main activity is sorting colored water. Each level displays bottles containing several layers of different colors. You must move the liquid between these bottles until every non-empty bottle contains only one color.

The colors remain separate layers. You are organizing them, not mixing them to create new colors.

HOW THE POURING CONTROLS WORK

Tap a bottle to select it, then tap another bottle to pour liquid into it.

A pour is allowed when the destination bottle has enough empty space and either contains no liquid or has the same color on top as the liquid being moved.

Only the uppermost color can be poured. To move a color underneath another layer, you must first remove the liquid above it. You cannot pour into a full bottle or place a color on top of a different color.

Continue moving the layers until the colors are separated into single-color bottles. Bottles that are not needed can remain empty.

EXAMPLE OF A MOVE

If one bottle has blue liquid above red liquid, you must move the blue liquid before you can access the red.

You can pour that blue liquid into an empty bottle or another bottle with blue liquid on top, as long as there is enough room. Removing the blue layer exposes the red layer and creates another possible move.

SOLVING THE LEVELS

Look at the arrangement before choosing a bottle. Empty bottles provide temporary storage and help you reach colors trapped beneath other layers.

A move that matches two colors may still leave you without enough space for the next step. Consider both the color you are moving and the layer that will be exposed afterward.

Completing the sorting objective clears the current level and allows you to continue to the next puzzle.

CG ILLUSTRATION COLLECTION

In addition to the water sorting levels, Vial Magic: Color Sort includes CG artwork, meaning digital illustrations that players can unlock and collect.

Progress through the puzzle levels to meet the game's artwork unlock requirements. Unlocked illustrations become available in the in-game gallery, where you can open and view the pictures you have collected.

The illustrations are collection content, separate from the sorting board. The core gameplay remains moving colored liquid between bottles to solve puzzles.

MAIN FUNCTIONS

Water sorting levels with layered colored liquids.

Tap controls for selecting a source bottle and a destination bottle.

Pouring rules based on matching colors and available bottle space.

Level progression through completed sorting puzzles.

Collectible CG illustrations unlocked through game progress.

An in-game gallery for viewing unlocked artwork.

Vial Magic: Color Sort combines bottle-sorting puzzles with picture collection. Solve the liquid arrangements, advance through the levels, and build your CG illustration collection.

apps.title: Hookbound
apps.summary:
Hook 'em. Eat 'em. Get huge.

You are a butcher with a cleaver, a hook and a big appetite. Drag anywhere on the screen to roam the land, and your cleaver and hook strike on their own. See a green number over a monster? Throw your hook, devour it and grow bigger and stronger.

HUNT AND GROW
• Chop monsters into meat, or hook and swallow them whole
• Every meal makes you bigger, tougher and hungrier
• Level up and pick a new perk: extra hooks, bloodthirst, rage and more

SELL, FORGE, REPEAT
• Haul your meat to the shop and cash it in
• Spend coins at the forge: a sharper cleaver, a longer hook, a thicker hide and a bigger sack
• Build a hunters' hut and hire hunters. They keep bringing meat even while you're away

FIVE WILD LANDS
• Juicy Meadows, Howling Woods, Stinkmire, Mount Scorch and Castle Dread
• Each land has its own monsters and a boss guarding the next gate
• Take on King Gloop, Alpha Fang, the Bogfather, Cinderjaw and the mighty Dreadwing

Simple one-finger controls, short sessions and a steady feeling of growth. How huge can you get?

apps.title: Survival War
apps.summary:
Survive the Zombie Outbreak. Control the Dead Zone.

A secret bioweapon experiment has gone wrong.
The zombie virus has consumed Hadforth, a sealed-off industrial town filled with infected streets, ruined shelters, abandoned hospitals, and underground labs.

Now three forces fight for control:

The National Guard wants to contain the outbreak.
Wilmed Biopharma wants to recover samples and erase the evidence.
The infected swarm wants to spread, evolve, and consume everything.

Build your shelter, recruit heroes, search for resources, and lead your squad through deadly outbreak zones. Every mission is a choice: scavenge deeper, fight harder, or extract before you lose everything.

Game Features

Build and upgrade your shelter to survive the apocalypse.

Search abandoned zones for food, supplies, weapons, and rare resources.

Experience search-fight-extract gameplay where every run brings danger and reward.

Train and upgrade heroes with unique skills and squad roles.

Capture key locations and fight tactical battles for control of the town.

Face zombies, mutants, infected nests, and rival factions.

Choose how the outbreak ends: cleanse it, control it, or let it spread.

In this post-apocalyptic zombie survival strategy game, every resource matters, every hero counts, and every expedition could be your last.

Take command, build your shelter, and survive the dead zone.

apps.title: Ricochet Grove
apps.summary:
One shot. So many hits.

Step into Ricochet Grove, a woodland adventure where clever angles turn a simple shot into a bouncing volley. Aim through gaps, ricochet off walls, and land repeated hits on the creatures ahead.

PLAN YOUR NEXT BOUNCE
Look for angles that keep your shots bouncing between enemies. Hit several targets in one volley or focus your fire on a tougher opponent. Every bounce is another chance to make your shot count.

GROW YOUR VOLLEY
Add more balls to your volley and fill the grove with bouncing shots. Line up a strong opening angle and watch your volley chip away at enemy health as it travels across the field.

POWER UP YOUR SHOTS
Discover powers that bring new effects to your attacks. Experiment with different upgrades and combinations to build a playstyle that suits you.

OUTSMART THE GROVE
Face a cast of woodland creatures, from leafy sprouts to armored foes and flower-like enemies. Choose your targets and adjust your aim as the field changes.

TAKE ON BIG BOSSES
Put your aiming skills and chosen powers to work against oversized opponents. Find useful ricochet angles and make the most of every volley.

Features:
• Aim-and-bounce combat with repeated hits
• Growing volleys and satisfying shot chains
• Powers and upgrades to shape your playstyle
• Varied woodland enemies and large boss encounters
• A colorful grove filled with playful plant creatures

apps.title: AutoRace: Idle Racing
apps.summary:
AutoRace is a one-thumb racing game. Your car drives itself – you choose when to switch lanes, when to hit the turbo and which skill card to take.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap the left or right side of the screen to switch lanes
• Nail the turbo at the start for a flying launch
• At each gate, pick 1 of 3 skill cards and turn the race around
• Every race is a fight for position all the way to the flag

BUILD YOUR CAR
• Upgrade five parts: engine, body, tyres, front wing and rear wing
• Merge two parts of the same grade into a stronger one, up to grade 13
• Each part improves one stat, so you can feel every upgrade on track

RECRUIT DRIVERS
• 16 drivers with their own skill cards – rarer drivers add a special skill
• Raise driver mastery to unlock new skills and stat boosts
• Check your drivers' condition before the green light

CLIMB THE LEAGUES
• Race from Bronze to Champion across 30 stages
• Take on the Grand Prix Challenge: 16 racers, no cards, pure racing
• Earn extra rewards from the Racing Pass and daily missions

QUICK RACES, REAL TRACKS
• Circuits modelled on the layouts of famous race tracks
• Races take just a few minutes – perfect for a quick break

Start your engine and race to the top!

apps.title: GoreBox 27
apps.summary:
GoreBox 27 is a physics sandbox shooter. Every character is a GoreDoll: a full ragdoll with its own skeleton, organs and blood.

Play alone, against bots or online with other players.

DAMAGE
• Damage is tracked per body part: broken bones, failing organs and blood loss from each wound
• Lose the arm holding a gun and the gun falls. Lose the legs or break the spine and the GoreDoll crawls
• Knockouts, concussions and bleeding out, with GoreDolls that wake up and get back on their feet
• Blades and axes take off arms, legs and heads, and explosions tear bodies apart
• Wounds and burns stay on bodies, and blood stays on the ground
• Your own character takes the same damage, down to bruises and torn clothing
• The Body Inspector shows a body's vitals and organ function, and Status Indicators show how your character feels

FIRE, EXPLOSIVES AND RADIATION
• Fire spreads through grass, wood, cloth and spilled fuel, and smoke fills rooms and chokes GoreDolls
• GoreDolls catch fire and burn to death unless the fire is put out
• Explosives from propane tanks and gas cans to missiles, the Neutron Bottle and the Aerial Bomb, a nuclear bomb
• Radioactive fallout drifts with the wind, causes radiation sickness and can turn GoreDolls into Mutants

WEAPONS AND PROPS
• Firearms with recoil and handling based on real calibres
• Bullets go through walls, depending on the calibre and the wall's thickness
• 25 melee weapons, from the Katana to the Frying Pan, with heavy swings and blocking
• The Reality Crusher: grab anything physical, fling it, tear it apart or crush it, and build fences and walls
• Over 200 props, including turrets, TVs, live cameras, jump pads and teleporters

BOTS AND NPCS
• Ten kinds of NPC, from Regulars and Officers to Convicts, Maniacs, Mutants and Divines, each with its own background. Some fight back, some run and some surrender
• Bots take cover, react to gunshots, search where they last saw you, fight with melee weapons and man turrets
• Set each NPC's skill, and save an NPC with its weapons, look and side as your own spawn card

MULTIPLAYER
• Crossplay between PC and mobile
• Host a game for friends, invite them from your friends list, or browse public servers
• Dedicated servers, LAN games, voice and text chat, and vote-kicks
• Hosts set the rules, kick players, sell roles and run their server's own money, GB$
• Clans, each with its own bank and emblem

GAMEMODES
• Sandbox, with no rules or objectives
• Free for all, Team deathmatch, Gun Game, Maniac Mystery, Infection, Mutant survival, Juggernaut, Riot, Invasion and more
• Bots can fill in for players in any gamemode
• Make your own gamemodes from triggers and actions, with lives, teams, zones and secret roles

WORLD
• Day and night, with a moon that goes through its phases, and clouds, rain and storms
• A car to drive, which hurts whoever it hits and whoever is inside when it crashes

CREATE YOUR OWN
• Build maps in the Map Editor on PC, with houses, working doors, lifts and water to swim in, and play them straight away
• Publish maps on the Workshop and play the ones other players made
• Save a scene with everything built in it, its NPCs and where everyone stands, and load it again later
• Customise your character down to the face, with hairstyles, beards, hats, masks and clothes in any colour

Full controller support, and touch controls on mobile.

EARLY ACCESS
This is an early access version of GoreBox 27. You will run into bugs, and parts of the game are unfinished or still missing. Nothing you see here is final.

GoreBox 27 is only a few months old and has far less content than GoreBox Animosity for now. New updates will keep adding more. If you find a bug, please report it on our Discord server.

GoreBox 27 contains graphic violence, blood and gore, and online interaction with other players. It is not made for children.

apps.title: City Transport Manager
apps.summary:
What would public transport in your city look like if you could plan it yourself?
In City Transport Manager, you found your own transport company on real maps. Place stops, plan your first bus lines and build a network of buses, trams and metro lines step by step. You decide which districts to connect and how your passengers get where they're going.

YOUR CITY AS THE GAME WORLD
Start in your hometown or discover somewhere new. Real streets, buildings and interesting destinations form the basis of your transport network. Connect residential areas with workplaces, shopping and leisure activities, and expand your service area bit by bit.

FROM YOUR FIRST BUS LINE TO A FULL NETWORK
Set your routes, place stops in the right spots and keep transfers short. Unlock trams and metro lines and combine the different modes of transport so that individual lines become one connected network.

THE RIGHT VEHICLES FOR YOUR LINES
Grow your fleet from small minibuses to articulated buses and double-deckers. Put larger vehicles on high-demand routes and enlarge your depot as your company grows. Trams and metro trains open up new possibilities for busy connections.

GOOD CONNECTIONS, HAPPY PASSENGERS
Your passengers have specific destinations and transfer between your lines. Wait times, the routes they take and full vehicles all affect their satisfaction. Keep an eye on demand, adjust how your vehicles are deployed and improve your service where it's needed.

YOUR COMPANY, YOUR DECISIONS
Set ticket prices, keep track of revenue and operating costs, and invest in your next expansion. Choose operating hours and run your fleet automatically or tailored to the time of day. Strike the balance between an attractive service and a profitable operation.

GROW WITH EVERY SUCCESS
Complete goals, reach milestones and earn stars for research, new areas and upgrades. Unlock more vehicle categories and open up more and more of your city.

Turn your first line into a network that connects your city.

apps.title: Secret Jigsaw Charm
apps.summary:
Secret Jigsaw Charm

Secret Jigsaw Charm is a casual jigsaw puzzle game that combines picture assembly with beautiful CG character image collection. Solve puzzles piece by piece, complete pictures, unlock new character artwork, and build your own collection as you progress through the game.

Classic Jigsaw Puzzle Gameplay

Enjoy the fun of assembling scattered puzzle pieces into a complete picture. Each puzzle challenges you to observe image details, recognize patterns, and find the correct positions for individual pieces.

Look carefully at the shapes, colors, edges, and patterns of each piece. Identify pieces that belong together and gradually connect them to complete the image. Every correct placement brings you closer to solving the puzzle.

How to Play

Step 1. Start a Puzzle

Choose an available puzzle and begin assembling the picture. Examine the image and pay attention to its colors, shapes, and visual details.

Step 2. Examine the Pieces

Study the individual puzzle pieces. Look for matching colors, connecting edges, and image fragments that appear to belong to the same area.

Step 3. Assemble the Picture

Move the puzzle pieces into their correct positions. Use visual clues and piece shapes to determine where each fragment belongs. Continue connecting the pieces until the image gradually takes shape.

Step 4. Complete the Puzzle

Finish assembling all the pieces to complete the picture. Each completed puzzle represents your progress and gives you the opportunity to discover more artwork.

Step 5. Unlock CG Character Images

Complete puzzles to unlock beautiful CG character images. Add newly discovered artwork to your collection and continue playing to discover more pictures.

Collect Beautiful CG Images

Secret Jigsaw Charm offers more than the satisfaction of completing a puzzle. It also gives you a collection goal to pursue as you play.

Each completed puzzle can help you discover new CG character artwork. Progress through the game, unlock images, and gradually expand your personal collection. Every new picture adds to your collection and gives you another reason to continue your puzzle adventure.

Relax and Enjoy Puzzle Solving

The game is easy to understand and focuses on observation, picture matching, and logical thinking. Take your time to examine the pieces, find visual connections, and gradually complete each image.

Whether you enjoy relaxing puzzle games or like the challenge of assembling pictures from scattered pieces, Secret Jigsaw Charm offers an enjoyable way to spend your free time.

Game Features

Classic jigsaw puzzle gameplay based on assembling picture pieces.

Visual challenges that encourage observation and attention to detail.

Beautiful CG character artwork to unlock and collect.

A collection system that rewards your progress through completed puzzles.

Casual gameplay that is easy to understand and suitable for short play sessions.

Begin Your Puzzle Adventure

Every picture begins with scattered pieces. Find the right connections, complete each puzzle, and discover beautiful CG character images along the way.

If you enjoy jigsaw puzzles, picture completion challenges, and collecting character artwork, Secret Jigsaw Charm is ready for you to explore.

Download Secret Jigsaw Charm and start your puzzle collection today.

apps.title: Wordeex
apps.summary:
Ever been lost for words? Wordeex turns that feeling into a word puzzle game.

16 letters. A hidden set of words. Can you find them?

Each puzzle starts with a keyboard made from the letters of three to five hidden words. Your task is to find those specific words and use every letter.

Find a correct word and its letters disappear, leaving you with the letters you need for the remaining answers. But there’s a twist: a real word isn’t always one of the words you’re looking for.

Sometimes the answer jumps out at you. Sometimes you stare right at it and swear it doesn’t exist.

Then, suddenly, you see it.

That’s Wordeex.

EVERY WORD CHANGES THE PUZZLE
Vocabulary helps. Logic makes the difference. Find a word, watch its letters disappear and take another look at what’s left. Your next answer could be right there.

GUESS, RETHINK, TRY AGAIN
Haven’t found the right word yet? Keep going. Your previous guesses stay visible, and a counter shows when you’ve tried the same word more than once. Yes, it happens.

A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY DAY
Take on the daily Wordeex, shared by everyone playing in the same language. Solve it and share your result with friends.

EXPLORE THE CHAPTERS
Work your way through puzzles with different levels of difficulty. Some reveal starting letters and word lengths. Others show only the lengths. The toughest reveal neither.

TEST YOUR SKILLS IN ACADEMY
Ready for a greater challenge? Academy is a competitive mode with no hints. It adapts to your skill based on your completion times and number of guesses. As you improve, tackle puzzles with less common words and solve tougher challenges to climb the leagues faster.

CREATE A CHALLENGE OF YOUR OWN
Build your own Wordeex and share it with friends or the community. Can they uncover the words you’ve hidden?

PLAY OFFLINE
No connection? Keep solving Wordeex wherever you are—even in airplane mode.

EXPLORE 27 LANGUAGES
Play in your own language or try one you’re learning. Each language has a dictionary of 3,000 common words. Some will feel familiar. Others might become new favorites.

ALL GAME CONTENT IS FREE
Earn coins by completing puzzles and spend them on hints to help you outside Academy. Wordeex includes ads and optional in-app purchases for coins, ad removal and bundles. You can also choose to watch a rewarded ad after solving a puzzle to double your coin reward.

Think you’ve cracked it?
Find the hidden words. Use every letter. Solve the Wordeex.

Terms and Conditions: https://wordeex.com/terms/

Every engine has a power target and an efficiency target. Upgrade it part by part, find what is holding it back, and certify it at the redline to unlock the next build. Mopeds, dirt bikes, V-twins, inline-4s, flat-4s, straight-6s, V8s, V12s, W16s and giant radials: 24 engines, each one animated piston by piston, with an engine note to match.

BUILD

• Upgrade intake, exhaust, ignition, fuel, cooling and boost parts

• Certify each engine for power and efficiency, then build the next one

TUNE
• Dial in air/fuel, spark advance and cam timing by hand
• Choose piston crowns, engine shapes and firing orders
• Race rival engines up the dyno league, from Rookie to Legend

COLLECT AND RESEARCH
• Open toolbox chests and collect 56 part cards in 5 rarities
• Research lasting upgrades in the R&D Lab, even while you are offline
• Daily goals and free daily chests
• Rebuild as Mk II, Mk III and beyond, and keep your cards and research

• Offline earnings while you are away
• Calm, clean visuals and satisfying engine sounds
• No account needed. Your progress is saved on your device.
• Perfect for fans of idle games, tycoon games, car games and engine simulators

Welcome to Pink Pour Water Sort, a relaxing water-sort puzzle game built around color sorting and careful pouring.

Your goal is simple: pour colored water between bottles until every bottle contains only one color. Tap a bottle to select it, then tap another bottle to pour the top layer of water. Each completed level unlocks an entry in the in-game CG gallery. These CG entries are collectible 2D game illustrations that serve as level-completion rewards. You can view unlocked illustrations in the gallery. The CG gallery is a reward and collection feature, while the core gameplay remains water sorting and color classification.

Game features:

Water-sort puzzle gameplay: select bottles, pour water, and sort colors.

Multiple levels with different color arrangements.

Complete levels to unlock in-game CG illustrations and gallery entries.

Undo and restart options to help you adjust your strategy.

Simple tap controls and liquid pouring animations.

Suitable for short breaks or longer play sessions.

Play at your own pace and solve each color-sorting puzzle.

Goal:
Separate the mixed colors so that every bottle contains only one color. Complete the current level to unlock the next level and its corresponding CG gallery reward.

This is a casual puzzle game focused on water sorting and color classification. The in-game CG illustrations are level rewards and collection content.

Liquid Sort Vialette

Welcome to Liquid Sort Vialette, a colorful and relaxing liquid sorting puzzle game that challenges your logic, planning, and problem-solving skills!

Pour, sort, and organize colorful liquids into bottles until every color is perfectly sorted. With vibrant visuals, unique bottle shapes, helpful boosters, and increasingly challenging puzzles, Liquid Sort Vialette offers a fun and satisfying experience for puzzle lovers of all ages.

Colorful Liquid Sorting Gameplay

The goal of Liquid Sort Vialette is simple: sort the liquids by color until each bottle contains only one color.

Each level presents bottles filled with different layers of colorful liquids. Your task is to choose the right bottles and carefully transfer liquids to separate the colors.

Every move requires thoughtful planning. Consider the order of the liquid layers, make use of available space, and find the best way to complete each puzzle. As you progress, new arrangements provide fresh challenges that put your logic and strategy to the test.

How to Play

Select a Bottle: Tap a bottle to choose the liquid you want to pour.

Pour the Liquid: Select another suitable bottle to transfer the liquid.

Sort the Colors: Organize the liquids until each bottle contains a single color.

Plan Your Moves: Think ahead and manage the available space carefully.

Complete Levels: Finish each sorting puzzle to win and advance to the next challenge.

The controls are simple and intuitive, making it easy to get started. However, finding the right sequence of moves can require careful thought and strategic planning.

Helpful Boosters

When a puzzle becomes difficult, helpful boosters can give you another way forward.

Undo: Reverse a previous move and try a different strategy.

Hint: Get help when you are unsure which move to make next.

Extra Bottle: Add an extra bottle to create more space for sorting liquids.

Use these tools wisely to overcome challenging puzzles and discover new ways to organize the colors.

Earn Rewards and Make Progress

Every completed level brings new opportunities to progress and collect rewards.

Earn in-game currency and gems as you explore the available reward features. Visit the shop to discover available items and resources, participate in reward activities, and work toward streak rewards as you continue your journey.

Keep solving puzzles, make strategic decisions, and enjoy the satisfaction of completing each level.

Bright Colors and Satisfying Visuals

Liquid Sort Vialette combines colorful liquids, glossy glass bottles, and vibrant visual effects to create an enjoyable casual gaming experience.

Watch the different colors flow between bottles as you work toward the perfect arrangement. Every successful sort brings you closer to completing the puzzle and enjoying that satisfying moment when all the colors are in their proper places.

apps.title: Bonfire Survivors: Roguelike
apps.summary:
The forest is dark, the night is long, and your bonfire is the only light. Keep it burning until dawn!

Bonfire is a one-thumb roguelike survival game. A lone hero guards the campfire while monsters pour out of the dark. Your weapons strike on their own: you choose where to fight, when to chop and when to run back to the fire.

🔥 THE LIGHT IS YOUR BATTLEFIELD
The glow of the bonfire marks the edge of the world. Beyond it lies the dark. Monsters march on the fire and knock logs out of it, and a lost log comes back as a walking fir. Chop it down and throw the log back in!

🪓 CHOP, CARRY, FEED THE FIRE
Fell trees with your axe and haul the logs to the bonfire. A bigger fire spreads the light wider and uncovers hidden caches. Every fire level brings a fire card: call defenders to guard the flame, fortify it or spread its light.

🐉 HATCH A DRAGON
Find a dragon egg, lay it in the fire, and a dragon will guard the flame until dawn.

⚔️ A NEW BUILD EVERY NIGHT
Slay monsters for XP, level up and pick new weapons and skills from a choice of cards. No two nights play the same.

👹 MINIBOSSES AND WARLORDS
Every night builds up to a boss fight. Face Baba Yaga, Koschei the Deathless, Viy and other monsters of old forest tales, and fell the warlord to bring the dawn.

🔨 FORGE BETWEEN NIGHTS
Collect coins and upgrade your weapons at the forge. Forge levels are yours for good, and weapons change their look as they rank up. Even a lost night keeps its coins and finds, so every run moves you forward.

🌲 FROM THE GLADE TO THE THICKET
Push from a sunny glade into the deep, dark forest. Every stage is darker, with new bosses and new finds.

Light the fire. Hold back the dark. Survive until dawn!

Ride along with the brave pups of PAW Patrol in this game for young kids. Help out with rescue missions, lend a paw at the pet salon and much more.

Join the PAW Patrol for playful adventures! Kids can dive into open-ended play, coloring and more with their favorite PAW Patrol pups in this interactive mobile experience designed for preschoolers. With engaging playsets and exciting Helping Paws missions, children can explore and lend a friendly paw all around Adventure Bay.

With no right or wrong way to play, kids are free to create, tell their own stories, discover at their own pace and learn the value of community service and teamwork — all alongside the PAW Patrol! No ads. No Wi-Fi required. Just flexible, imaginative fun.

In this kid-friendly game, little ones can explore the following vibrant playsets filled with surprises, coloring, silly interactions and opportunities to build, discover and create:

• The Lookout: Experience transformative vehicle play as you drive around the Lookout with the PAW Patrol!
• Katie's Pet Parlor: Help Katie run her pet shop. Bathe pups, style a new look or help customers purchase items from the store.
• Rocky's Garage: Green means go with Rocky and friends! Repair vehicles, have a dance party and turn junk-pile trash into treasure.
• Porter's Café: Step inside and become a chef. Fire up delicious pizzas and treats to feed your favorite PAW pals!
• Francois's Art Festival: Unleash your creativity at the Art Festival! Bring coloring pages to life and build collages with stickers earned from your adventures.

Take part in these Helping Paws minigames, where teamwork and kindness come first as pups respond to calls from friendly Adventure Bay citizens:

• Use Chase's tennis ball launcher to lend a helping hand.
• Wield Marshall's water cannon to make a splash.
• Take flight in Skye's helicopter to spot hidden objects.
• Pilot Zuma's hovercraft and launch buoys to rescue Cap'n Turbot.
• Control Rocky's extender claw to repair Cap'n Turbot's ship.
• Drive Rubble's bulldozer to help feed the farm.

apps.title: THE GOAT: Sports Legend
apps.summary:
You're a teenager with a dream: becoming the greatest athlete of all time. The GOAT.

THE GOAT is a sports career simulator played one card at a time, a life sim where every swipe is a choice. Each card is a moment of your life: swipe left or right to decide. From the youth academy to your last match, every decision writes your story.

ONE CHOICE, REAL CONSEQUENCES
Junk food the night before the final? A huge party with training at 9 a.m.? An agent promising you the contract of a lifetime? Every decision moves your five gauges: Talent, Health, Mind, Social and Fame. Watch your money too: salary, bonuses, sponsors and the temptations of success.

CREATE YOUR PLAYER
Pick a ready-made talent or create your own player: boy or girl, face, first name, country and position. On the pitch, the sport is football (soccer): play as a striker, midfielder, defender or goalkeeper. Your character grows older season after season, and you can run several careers side by side.

MORE SPORTS ON THE WAY
Football (soccer) is the first sport in THE GOAT. Basketball, tennis, rugby and motor racing are coming next.

FROM THE ACADEMY TO THE TOP
Start in a youth academy, fight for your first pro contract, then climb from small clubs to the elite. Deal with the coach, training, injuries, national team call-ups, the press, fans, rivals and family. After each card comes your month in review: your games, your goals and your club's place in the league table.

TRANSFERS AND CONTRACTS
Clubs come knocking. A transfer you accept happens at the next window, mid-season or at the end of the season, with clubs named after cities all over the world. Stay loyal, or chase a bigger stage.

LIVE MATCHES
Some big matches are played live: pick the coach's plan, then swipe at each key moment. A shot, a tackle, a one-on-one with the keeper: your choices change the score.

A CARD GAME AND A COLLECTION
Every card you play for the first time joins your collection, from Common to Legendary through Bronze, Silver and Gold. Open a card to see what would have happened if you had chosen the other side. Super choice swaps the current card for a rarer one, and Go back replays your last card. Your feats earn feat cards, which give you an edge in your next career.

SEASONS, TROPHIES AND RANKINGS
Each season ends with your stats for your position (goals, saves and clean sheets for a goalkeeper) and your trophies: league titles, cups, international titles and individual awards such as top scorer or best goalkeeper. The rankings list real players only: World, Legends, Top scorers, Playmakers and Goalkeepers. They move day by day.

CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS
After a live match, send the same match to a friend with a link and see who does better.

ENERGY
Your first cards are free, and free cards come back over time. To keep going without waiting, each decision uses energy: energy packs in the shop, and free energy every day with the daily bonus.

UNLIMITED CHARACTERS
3 characters are free. The optional Unlimited characters subscription lets you play as many as you want, with no ads interrupting your game (the reward videos you choose to watch stay available).

• A sports career from the academy to retirement, one card at a time
• Live soccer matches decided by your choices
• More than 1,000 cards to collect, from Common to Legendary
• Available in 31 languages

An internet connection is required: the league regularly records your games. THE GOAT is free to download, with in-app purchases and ads. Clubs carry the names of cities; the clubs, players and competitions in the game are fictional.

apps.title: Rummy 500: Classic Card Game
apps.summary:
Welcome to Rummy 500: Classic Card Game – a meticulously crafted offline mobile game that lets you immerse yourself in the strategy and challenge of a classic card game anytime, anywhere! Whether you're a seasoned card player or new to Rummy-style games, enjoy smooth gameplay, smart AI opponents, and comfortable large-font visuals for an authentic Rummy 500 experience. Completely free, no internet needed. Start your journey to 500 points now!

🎯 Objective
In Rummy 500, your goal is to earn points by forming "sets" (three or four cards of the same rank) or "runs" (three or more consecutive cards of the same suit). After each round, players who meld cards score points. The first to reach 500 points wins!
With its fast pace and rich strategy, you'll need to be flexible, observe opponents, and control the game to claim victory.

✨ Features
Authentic Rummy 500 – Faithful to classic rules and scoring for pure card game fun.
Adaptive Smart AI – AI opponents adjust difficulty as you improve, from easy to highly challenging.
Large, Clear Interface – Optimized for mobile with big cards and a clean layout, easy on the eyes.
Offline Play – No internet required. Enjoy a well-designed card game anytime, anywhere.
Stats & History – Track your win rate, high scores, and game history to refine your strategy.
Smooth & Elegant Design – Subtle animations and comfortable colors for a visually pleasing experience.
Completely Free – Built purely for card game enthusiasts.

🃏 How to Play
Draw – Take a card from the deck or discard pile.
Meld – Form and lay down "sets" or "runs" to score points.

apps.title: Invokers: Titan Legacy
apps.summary:
Hack and slash your way through a vibrant fantasy world, battling epic bosses and hundreds of different enemies along the way. Crush waves of skeletons, goblins, and ogres – then face off against fearsome dragons, colossal giants, deadly demons, and much more.

Explore a vast world and discover a huge variety of stunning locations and enemies. Craft your perfect team: summon legendary Invokers and powerful Titans and experience the most exciting Action RPG combat on mobile – this is a true AAA mobile game. Adventure across tons of levels and beat huge dungeon bosses to win the best loot.

COLLECT INVOKERS & TITANS

Summon over a hundred Invokers from a variety of different Factions and customize your fantasy team: play as orcs, elves, humans – or someone a little more furry. And that's not all – summon powerful Titans and bind them to your Invokers to call upon legendary power.

INVOKE TITANS

When the time's right, unleash the ultimate power – Invoke a Titan and transform into a super powered fantasy creature to take down anything that stands in your way.

FIGHT EPIC BOSS BATTLES

Face off against classic monsters and bosses and experience the best boss battles on mobile! Go to war against the terrifying Corrupted Dragon, the cold-hearted Ice Queen, the merciless Demon Lord, and many more – in the best Action MMORPG battles around.

FAST-PACED ACTION COMBAT

Don't waste time taking turns – Invokers: Titan Legacy is all-action, all the time. Invokers takes all the tactics and strategy of turn-based battle RPGs, but boosts the excitement to a new level with fast, flashy, action gameplay.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR TEAM

With billions of different team combinations and ways to develop your Invokers, you can play exactly how you want. Equip your team with powerful relics, then upgrade their skills to fit your strategy and tactics – bring deadly attackers, tough tanks, helpful healers, powerful sorcerers, or whatever you need to take down your next target.

CLIMB THE SPIRES

Craft the perfect strategy and build your teams to climb the towers to glory. Each legendary elemental tower requires a fully custom team. Master the elements and claim your victory.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Play how you want – whenever, wherever. Take full control of every Invoker, every skill, and every ability – or play on Auto mode to kick back, relax, and watch your awesome team do their thing.

And no internet, no problem. You can play Invokers offline – no matter where you are in the world. On a plane? At the bottom of the sea? Upgrade your experience with non-stop action-packed Invokers battles.

STUNNING 3D GRAPHICS

From the gorgeous, fully-animated 3D characters to the richly detailed, vibrant biomes, Invokers offers a vivid world you can immerse yourself in. And with thousands of unique skill animations and effects, action RPG combat has never looked more exciting.

EXPLORE A DEEP FANTASY WORLD

Get to know every Invoker in Amara, with fully fleshed out lore and bios for every single character – along with an expansive world map to discover. The world of Invokers is deep, complex, and rich with story.

Slide, sift, and relax! Sifty Sands: No Timer is a calming color puzzle where every move sends a satisfying shower of sand into place.

Colorful sand fills the top of every board. Slide the blocks into position beneath it, and matching sand pours down to fill them up. apps.title: Score Royale
apps.summary:
Score Royale turns a standard 52-card deck into a strategy board. Lay your cards out across five tracks, complete classic card combinations, and settle each track for points. Every card you place changes what the next one is worth.

Each round deals you a full deck and five open tracks. A track holds up to five cards and settles the moment it is full, so the order you play matters as much as the cards you keep. Take the safe pairing, or set a card aside in the swap area and reach for a stronger combination.

Five tracks, five spaces each — arrange all 52 cards and settle every track
Classic card combinations, from a simple pair up to the strongest five-card run
Stacked multipliers — the tougher the combination, the higher the score
Swap area to set a card aside and rebuild your layout
Time and heart rewards added to your final result
Four rooms with different deck counts, timers and target scores
Daily challenges and match history to follow your progress
A guided tutorial covering every combination and multiplier

The four rooms each play differently. Bronze gives you room to learn, Silver and Gold tighten the clock, and Diamond asks for the highest target score of all with the least time to reach it. Beat a room's target score and it stays unlocked. The round also ends when your hearts run out or the last card is played.

Start as a guest in seconds, or register with an email address to carry your progress between devices. If your hearts run out or the clock beats you, one optional rewarded ad lets you continue, once per round.

Score Royale is a single-player card strategy game. In-game coins are earned through gameplay only and cannot be purchased or exchanged.

apps.title: Sand Hole: Block Sort Jam
apps.summary:
Sort colored sand, free your blocks, and fill every one of them to 100%. Sand Hole: Block Sort Jam is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the sand really moves.

HOW IT WORKS
Every level gives you framed panels full of colored sand and a board full of colored blocks. Drag a block until it touches sand of its own color and it starts pulling that sand in, grain by grain. Fill a block to 100% and it pops off the board, freeing space for the rest. Clear all the sand and the level is yours.

One finger, one gesture. Drag. That is the whole control scheme.

THE SAND DOES THE WORK
This sand is not a flat picture. Pull from underneath a pile and it funnels down into a V. Pull from the side and the slope above it slides. A steep, sharp edge will stand there until something gives, then collapse all at once. Drain the same panel in a different order and it falls apart differently.

A REAL PUZZLE UNDER THE COLORS
Blocks cannot pass through each other, and a long shape wedged in a corridor stays wedged. So the order you complete blocks in is the actual puzzle: read the board, spot the block that frees the most room, and work outward from there.

Boards come in every shape, from open grids to narrow corridors and split chambers, and later levels keep several sand panels going at once. Some blocks even hold a second color inside: the inner layer fills first, then the outer one takes over.

The timer only starts when you make your first move, so study the board as long as you want before you touch anything.

BOOSTERS FOR THE TIGHT SPOTS
Hammer: splits a stuck block into single cells that slip through any gap.
Magnet: fills the selected block instantly and pops it.
Time Freeze: stops the clock while everything else keeps running.

FEATURES
- Satisfying color sort puzzle built on real sand physics
- Drag only controls, playable with one thumb
- Blocks in every shape: bars, squares, L shapes, T shapes
- Boards that keep changing shape: corridors, chambers, open grids
- Multiple sand panels running at the same time in later levels
- Bright pixel style sand in clean, saturated colors
- Three boosters: Hammer, Magnet, Time Freeze
- No wall of tutorials, you learn it in one drag

Drag, pull, pop. Your satisfying sand sort puzzle is ready when you are.

apps.title: Hexa Pop: Color Sort Puzzle
apps.summary:
Drag. Drop. Watch the colors stack up and BLOW UP!

Hexa Stack is a bright, fast hexa-sort puzzle. Drag one of three chip stacks onto the honeycomb board. Matching colors hop over from their neighbors, chip by chip, and every single-color tower of 10 or more bursts in a shower of confetti and coins.

HOW TO PLAY
• Pick one of the 3 stacks in the tray and drop it on any empty hex.
• Same-color chips on top slide across to join it, chaining from cell to cell.
• Stack 10 of one color to clear the tower and fill the goal bar.
• Keep space free: if the board fills up, the level is over.

WHY YOU'LL KEEP PLAYING
• Chain reactions: one smart drop can set off COMBO, AMAZING and INCREDIBLE streaks.
• Rainbow Bomb: clear every color to light the rainbow and fire a bomb that pulls a whole color into one giant blast.
• Wild chips: the rainbow WILD chip takes the color of its neighbors and rescues a tricky board.
• New worlds: a fresh board and sky every 25 levels, from amethyst and ocean to sunset and jade.
• 1000+ levels: new twists keep arriving, with breather levels and tough boss levels along the way.
• Quick levels: most take under a minute, and the next one starts straight away.
• Lucky Payday levels pay extra coins.
• Handy boosters: Undo, Hammer and Refresh get you out of a tight spot.
• Juicy toy look: glossy rainbow chips, big bursts and satisfying sounds.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Free to play. The game shows ads, and some rewards are unlocked by watching an optional ad.
• No in-app purchases.
• Play offline, no Wi-Fi needed for the puzzles.
• Simple to learn, one finger is all you need.

Relax, sort the colors and chase your biggest chain in Hexa Stack!

apps.summary:
The orcs are coming. Thousands of them.

In Horde Rush, an endless orc horde floods through the gates at the top of a canyon and rushes for your base. Every orc that gets through costs you. Your job: build an army that holds the line.

HOLD THE CANYON
The horde moves like a living flood. It squeezes through narrow passes, splits around rocks and piles up against your soldiers. Place your army where it counts and watch the line hold as wave after wave crashes into it.

BUILD YOUR ARMY
Start with a handful of warriors and grow a real army. Earn gold from every orc you defeat and spend it on more soldiers and stronger attacks. Archers, wizards, ninjas, grenadiers and plenty more.

UNLEASH EPIC SKILLS
Summon and level up skills. Rain fire on the horde, blow the orcs back up the canyon or pull them into a whirlwind.

FACE BIGGER THREATS
The deeper you go, the bigger the horde gets. Brutes, Big Orcs, Spear Orcs and plenty more march with the crowd and take far more to bring down.

BATTLEFIELDS
Every level is a new battlefield: winding roads, funnels, split canyons, islands, three-gate assaults and more. Each map changes how the horde moves and where your line should stand.

GROW STRONGER WITH EVERY RUN
Prestige to earn crowns and spend them on permanent upgrades for your whole army and on upgrade paths for every unit. Your army keeps earning while you are away, too.

How far can you hold the canyon?

apps.title: King Dies Rich: Roguelike TD
apps.summary:
The king will fall. His fortune won't.

King Dies Rich is a pixel-art roguelike tower defense where the king himself is the tower. Hold the throne against the undead, find powerful loot, and turn every defeat into a stronger kingdom: castle defense, roguelite, and RPG in one game.

HOLD THE THRONE
Your king stays on his throne as enemies close in from every side. Slide a finger to guide the attack circle while he strikes automatically. Pick the most dangerous targets, break up the horde, and survive the next boss. Choose drag or direct touch aiming to suit your play style.

SEVEN SCHOOLS OF POWER
Shape your build with Fire, Frost, Poison, Lightning, Guard, Blades, and Spirits. Burn the undead, freeze a crowd, unleash chain lightning, or surround the throne with blades and spirit archers. Equip matching gear to unlock Mastery and Dominion powers, from falling meteors to volleys of spectral arrows.

LOOT, EQUIP, REFORGE
Collect gear with different bonuses and school effects. Compare finds, equip legendary items, upgrade your favorites, and reforge their properties. Set gems in the throne and combine them into stronger gems as your Kingdom develops.

BUILD A LASTING KINGDOM
Spend the gold you earn on the Arsenal, Citadel, Treasury, Forge, and Mines. Buildings provide lasting upgrades and unlock more ways to improve your king. Your gold, gear, gems, and Kingdom progress stay with you when a siege ends, even if the king falls.

DEEPER HALLS, DEADLIER BOSSES
Battle through the Throne Hall, Crypt, and Chapel. Defeat each hall's boss to open the next, then face tougher enemies in the next circle. Discover the Bone Giant, the Maned and Chained Ghouls, and the Mourner. Fill your Bestiary as you learn what each enemy can do.

KING OF KINGS
After the first circle, King of Kings opens: the weekly race. Compete with other kings and climb from the Bronze league to the Crown league.

PLAY OFFLINE
An offline game for phones and tablets in landscape, with touch controls, adjustable sound, and optional vibration. Only the weekly race needs an internet connection. No account required.

Hold a little longer. Find a better crown. Die rich.

apps.title: Last Human: Final Stand
apps.summary:
The virus took everything. Cities crumble into ruins. The streets belong to the dead.
Last Human: Final Stand is a zombie shooter survival game where humanity's final defense depends on you alone — the last commander standing.

ZOMBIE SHOOTER ACTION
Pull the trigger or die. This is zombie shooting at its rawest — waves of undead
pour toward you, and every bullet counts. Aim fast, dodge faster. Massive zombie
hordes, mutated infected, brutal bosses. There is no retreat. Only survival.

BUILD YOUR SHELTER
The shooting stops. Survival doesn't. Rebuild from the rubble — upgrade buildings,
stockpile resources, reinforce your walls. Every barricade buys you one more day.
Your shelter is the last spark of human civilization.

RECRUIT YOUR HEROES
In the zombie apocalypse, some are born for this. Recruit heroes with unique
skills, level them up, gear them up, and assemble the deadliest zombie-killing
squad in the wasteland. The right lineup cuts a path through the impossible.

Nobody survives the apocalypse alone. Join an alliance and stand with survivors
across the world — take on massive zombie hordes together, defend each other's
territory, and fight for the resources that keep you alive. In this zombie war,
you win together or you fall alone.

EXPLORE THE WASTELAND
Step outside the walls. Push into infected cities, scavenge supplies, unlock new
zones, and take back what the dead stole from us. The wasteland is deadly — and
it pays.

If you crave zombie shooters and survival strategy, this is your last stand.

The horde won't wait.
Download now. Make your final stand.
